title: Foundation Construction

stage.name: Foundation
stage.description: Concrete footings and a foundation that everything else will rest on.

options: A wide concrete base that spreads the house's weight into the ground
questions.why: Footings spread the load so the house doesn't sink or settle unevenly.

questions.prompt: Why is steel rebar placed inside concrete?
options: It helps the concrete resist cracking when it's pulled or bent
questions.why: Concrete is strong when squeezed but weak when stretched. Steel takes the stretching.

questions.prompt: Concrete needs time to cure before heavy loads go on it.
questions.why: Concrete keeps gaining strength for weeks. Rushing it weakens the whole house.

questions.prompt: What is the foundation of a lasting relationship?
options: Trust, respect and shared core values
questions.why: Shared tastes are nice, but trust and respect carry the weight.

talk: What does trust look like to you in everyday life?
